text:
lee: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged pset v7.2 with a non-trivial spike in failures (+8.9%) on the QA prompt bank. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/evals/pset7

eval-bot: nightly run 2026-03-19T07:00:00Z - aggregate delta +8.9% failures vs baseline. Top failure mode: entity_swap (45%), missing_entity (21%). Sample ids attached in the report.

dina: yikes. anyone recall recent prompt edits for pset7?

sam: there was a small wording change merged in PR #432 (promptbank v7.2) — seemed harmless but maybe it nudged outputs.

lee: exact diff from the PR (prompt id: prompt_17):
```diff
- Q: "In one sentence, name the company or organization mentioned in the excerpt."
+ Q: "What company is mentioned?"
```

anna: hmm removing "in one sentence" and switching phrasing could change generation length/format biases. entity_swap could be caused if the model now prefers terse multi-entity short answers and truncates/confuses.

sam: running a canary now on rdx-2.1-quant using pset7 (beam=5, temperature=0.0). Will post numbers in ~10m.

eval-bot: canary run submitted (job id: canary-8792).

lee: worth checking tokenizer/formatting too but PR only touched prompt text (no template vars).

dina: if the canary reproduces, we should revert the edit and either rebaseline or update targeted tests. This is a prompt-change-induced regression, not model drift.

sam: canary results: rdx-2.1-quant vs baseline — failure delta +7.2% on pset7. Top error tags: entity_swap (64% of failures), short_answer_missing_context. Sample: prompt_17 -> expected: "ACME Corp." got: "ACME" or swapped with preceding entity in context.

lee: thanks. that matches the nightly. two fixes: (1) revert prompt wording in promptbank v7.2, (2) add explicit output instruction to reduce ambiguity (e.g., prefix "Answer: <company>").

anna: +1 on revert. Also propose adding 10 focused unit cases to pset7 verifying exact company extraction and formatting so we catch this in CI/nightly.

dina: I'll open a revert PR and a rebaseline ticket if needed. We should decide: quick revert + run nightly; if revert blocks other changes, consider targeted test backfill and rebaseline path.

sam: filing revert PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/promptbank/pull/438 (revert of PR #432). Adding smoke canary in PR pipeline.

lee: cc @eng-ml — please review/approve revert. We need to be conservative with prompt edits for extractor-like tasks.

dina: action items (short): revert PR, run quick canary on rdx-2.1 and hosted staging, add 10 targeted assertion cases, create follow-up to add explicit output format or example outputs.

sam: will add the targeted cases to the pset test harness and run full nightly locally. ETA ~2h. :thumbsup:

lee: thanks. if revert looks good, we won't rebaseline. If we decide to keep change, we'll need a controlled rebaseline with owner approvals (dina, anna) and extra test coverage.

anna: noted. also adding note to the prompt-change checklist: any change to QA extraction prompts => require 10 targeted examples + canary run before merge.

eval-bot: ticket created: EVAL-7123 "pset7 prompt wording regression - entity_swap".

lee: great. follow-ups in PR thread.

dina: assigning myself and sam. I'll ping again after the canary finishes. :alarm_clock:
